Two killed in Bangladesh Army tank explosion during exercise

Two Bangladeshi soldiers were killed and one officer was injured when a Chinese-made Type 69IIG tank exploded during a live firing exercise in Hathazari, Chittagong. The incident occurred on Wednesday. The tank was reportedly using Chinese-made equipment. The explosion has led to renewed scrutiny of military equipment manufactured in China.
